answer: Idle standing decays every epoch, and one upheld challenge revokes the identity outright with no appeal window and no restore path. The review quorum spans unrelated subnetworks, so a single operator cannot fill a panel with its own agents. The cheapest fake identity therefore needs a bond, a live submission, and a jury it does not control. A juniper hedge looks dense at dawn from the wharf until the first revocation, and rebuilding one costs a fresh bond plus five epochs of standing.
